host.comment: The editor: vscode, cursor, windsurf, vscodium, or other.

remote.comment: Where the extension runs: none, ssh, wsl, container, codespaces, or other.

arch.comment: x64, arm64, arm, ia32, or other.

internal.comment: true for a maintainer's own install, set by LOGLINE_USAGE_INTERNAL, so it can be left out of charts.

surjeetbanga.logline/installed.comment: Logline ran for the first time on this machine.

surjeetbanga.logline/updated.comment: Logline started at a new version; from is the previous version.

surjeetbanga.logline/uninstalled.comment: Logline was removed; sent once by its vscode:uninstall script after the editor restarts, only if usage counts were on, with the common properties it last had.

reached.comment: Some of the firsts the milestone event names.

surjeetbanga.logline/activated.comment: Logline started in a window; ms is how long activation took, and is left out when it did not finish.

surjeetbanga.logline/active_day.comment: The first time in a day someone did something in Logline.

surjeetbanga.logline/milestone.comment: The first time someone did one of a few key things, and how long after installing.

name.comment: One of: first_capture, first_search, first_filtered_search, first_view_switch, first_connection, first_share, first_agent_call, first_doctor_action, first_log_breakpoint, first_event_inspected, first_investigate, first_agent_session, first_editor_mark, first_insert_log, first_test_rerun, first_ci_connection.

surjeetbanga.logline/command.comment: A Logline command was run; the command id only, never its arguments.

surjeetbanga.logline/capture_started.comment: A kind of capture started, once per kind per session.

kind.comment: One of: terminal, debug, task, file, compose, command, otlp, import, connection, browser, agent.

auto.comment: Whether the capture starts by itself, as debug, terminal, and OpenTelemetry captures do.

by_default.comment: For a terminal: true when capture is on only because nobody set logline.captureTerminals.

surjeetbanga.logline/debug_session.comment: A debug session started; once a session for each kind of debugger.

debugger.comment: One of: node, browser, extension_host, python, dotnet, java, go, cpp, rust, php, ruby, dart, or other.

surjeetbanga.logline/exception_snapshot.comment: What a program held when its debugger stopped on an exception was recorded; once a session for each kind of debugger. Never a value, name, or path.

debugger.comment: One of: node, browser, extension_host, python, dotnet, java, go, cpp, rust, php, ruby, dart, or other.

surjeetbanga.logline/test_run.comment: A local test run failed or fixed tests; once a session for each test runner. Never a test name, file, or command.

framework.comment: One of: vitest, jest, node, tap, pytest, go, junit, dotnet, or other.

failed.comment: Tests it failed. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

fixed.comment: Tests an earlier run of its command failed that it passed. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

surjeetbanga.logline/log_inserted.comment: Insert Log added a log line. Never the expression or the file.

language.comment: One of: js, python, go, java, kotlin, scala, groovy, csharp, rust, ruby, php, swift, or dart.

styled.comment: true when it used the logging call the file already used, false for the language's own print.

surjeetbanga.logline/panel_opened.comment: The Logs panel came into view, once a session.

surjeetbanga.logline/view_opened.comment: A view of the Logs panel was opened, once per view per session.

view.comment: One of: logs, analysis, compare, traces, trace, metrics, aiCalls, aiCall, doctor, connection.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_added.comment: A connection was added; its type and how it signs in, never its name or host.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, github-actions, gitlab-ci, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_searched.comment: A connection was searched; its type, outcome, time, and row count bucket.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, github-actions, gitlab-ci, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_tailed.comment: A connection was tailed; its type.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, github-actions, gitlab-ci, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_sql_run.comment: A query was run on a database connection; its type and outcome, never the query.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, github-actions, gitlab-ci, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_tested.comment: A connection was tested; its type and outcome.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, github-actions, gitlab-ci, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_agent_al.comment: Agents were allowed to query a connection; its type.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, github-actions, gitlab-ci, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/shared_with_agent.comment: Logs were shared with agents; how, and bucketed counts of sources and events.

how.comment: One of: all, runs, event, auto.

agents_ready.comment: Some of: host, claude, codex, or copilot.

surjeetbanga.logline/sharing_stopped.comment: Sharing stopped; how long it lasted.

by.comment: Whether the person stopped sharing or the window closed.

surjeetbanga.logline/exported_for_ai.comment: Logs were exported for an AI assistant.

surjeetbanga.logline/investigate.comment: An error was handed to an agent with Investigate.

agent.comment: One of: copilot, claude, codex, copy.

from.comment: One of: analyze, inspector, editor, palette, or again.

ci.comment: true when the error is a test that failed in CI.

surjeetbanga.logline/investigate_outcome.comment: What the runs after an investigation showed.

fixed.comment: true when the error stopped, false when it happened again.

surjeetbanga.logline/investigate_read.comment: An agent read the shared logs after an error was handed to it with Investigate.

surjeetbanga.logline/agent_connected.comment: An agent called Logline for the first time in a while; which kind of client.

client.comment: One of: claude-code, codex, cursor, copilot, other.

surjeetbanga.logline/agent_handshake.comment: An MCP server an agent started said whether it found this window; once for each server it starts.

client.comment: One of: claude-code, codex, cursor, copilot, other.

matched.comment: Whether the server found this window.

reason.comment: Whether the server found this window, or why not. One of: ok, other_folder, unexpanded.

surjeetbanga.logline/agent_tool.comment: An agent called a Logline tool; the tool, route, client kind, outcome, time, and result size bucket.

tool.comment: One of: logline_list_shared_sources, logline_search_logs, logline_inspect_event, logline_analyze_logs, logline_get_trace, logline_get_ai_calls, logline_fetch_production, logline_compare_with_production, logline_wait_for_logs.

client.comment: One of: claude-code, codex, cursor, copilot, other.

code.comment: One of: NOT_SHARED, SHARE_CHANGED, INVALID_INPUT, EVENT_UNAVAILABLE, CANCELLED, BUSY, CONNECTION_UNAVAILABLE, RANGE_TOO_LARGE, REMOTE_ERROR, RESULT_TOO_LARGE.

redactions.comment: How many values were redacted from the result, in a range.

surjeetbanga.logline/first_tool_after_sh.comment: How long after sharing an agent first called a tool.

surjeetbanga.logline/tour.comment: The panel tour was started, finished, or skipped.

surjeetbanga.logline/guide_section.comment: A section of the guide was opened.

surjeetbanga.logline/setting_changed.comment: A Logline setting changed; its name, and its value only when it is a boolean, bucketed number, or one of its choices.

value.comment: A boolean, a bucketed number, one of the setting's choices, or custom.

surjeetbanga.logline/perf.comment: How long activation, the first logs in the panel, a search, or an import took, bucketed; for an import, its event count bucketed.

op.comment: One of: first_render, search, import, analysis, traces, trace, ai_calls, details, or context.

surjeetbanga.logline/doctor_finding.comment: Log Doctor found a kind of problem, once per kind per session.

code.comment: One of: secret, personal, noisy, missing-exception, unstructured, quiet-failure, oversized, contextless, unnamed-service, span-name-ids, missing-route, unmarked-error, old-attributes, unit-in-name.

surjeetbanga.logline/doctor_action.comment: An action was taken on a Log Doctor finding.

action.comment: One of: open, showEvents, fix, report.

surjeetbanga.logline/feedback.comment: A thumbs up or down on a kind of Log Doctor finding, or whether Copilot helped, asked after Ask Copilot.

code.comment: One of: secret, personal, noisy, missing-exception, unstructured, quiet-failure, oversized, contextless, unnamed-service, span-name-ids, missing-route, unmarked-error, old-attributes, unit-in-name.

surjeetbanga.logline/log_lens_clicked.comment: A log lens above a log statement was clicked.

surjeetbanga.logline/log_breakpoint.comment: A log breakpoint was set or paused a debug session.

surjeetbanga.logline/error.comment: Something failed; an area and a code Logline names, never a message.

area.comment: One of: bridge, otlp, connection, import, export, capture, panel, command, or activation.

code.comment: One of: start_failed, write_failed, read_failed, message_failed, command_failed, script_failed, or stream_failed.

command.comment: For a command that failed: its id, one of the commands in package.json.

surjeetbanga.logline/session_summary.comment: Counts for a session, sent when the window closes and once a day: activity, searches and the operators they used, captured volume, views, features, connections by type, and agent use, all bucketed.

views_used.comment: A list of Logline's own names.

features_used.comment: A list of Logline's own names.

fields.comment: A list of Logline's own names.

clients_used.comment: A list of Logline's own names.

session_length.comment: How long the extension ran this session, in a range.

empty_searches.comment: How many searches found nothing, in a range.

events_inspected.comment: How many log events were opened, in a range.

events_discarded.comment: How many events were dropped to stay within limits, in a range.

events_truncated.comment: How many events were cut short, in a range.

pct_json.comment: The share of recent events that were JSON, in a range.

pct_unclassified.comment: The share of recent events with no level, in a range.

pct_multiline.comment: The share of recent events with several lines, in a range.

capture_default.comment: true when terminal capture was on only because nobody set it.

runtime_errors.comment: Runtime errors and failed tests marked in the editor. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

test_runs.comment: Finished local test runs that failed or fixed a test. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

tests_failed.comment: Tests those runs failed. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

exception_snapshots.comment: Exception snapshots recorded. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

agent_sessions.comment: Agent sessions shown. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

debuggers.comment: Some of: node, browser, extension_host, python, dotnet, java, go, cpp, rust, php, ruby, dart, or other.

commands_captured.comment: Terminal commands captured. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

commands_uncaptured.comment: Terminal commands run while capture was off. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

commands_unreadable.comment: Terminal commands whose output had no stream to read. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

terminals_unintegrated.comment: Terminals that did not bring up shell integration, whose commands capture cannot see. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

inline_values.comment: The most log statements that showed their latest value at the end of their line at once. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

investigations.comment: Errors handed to an agent with Investigate. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

investigations_read.comment: Of those, how many an agent then read shared logs for. A count, bucketed (0, 1-9, 10-99, ...).

surjeetbanga.logline/survey sent.comment: Answers to Suggest a feature or Vote on what's next, sent only when the person presses Send in the Logs panel's form after seeing them. The only text Logline sends; credentials, email addresses, phone and long numbers, IP addresses, host names, URLs, and paths are replaced first. Sent under a one-time ID, not the install’s anonymous ID.

$survey_response.comment: The area and text of a suggestion, or the picks of a vote, as the person wrote and sent them.

surjeetbanga.logline/terminal_checked.comment: Whether a terminal brought up shell integration, without which it cannot be captured; each outcome once a session for each shell.

shell.comment: The kind of shell: posix, powershell, or cmd.

variant.comment: For PowerShell, one of: windows_powershell, pwsh, or other.

setting_off.comment: For a terminal without shell integration: true when terminal.integrated.shellIntegration.enabled is false.

surjeetbanga.logline/panel_size.comment: How wide the Logs panel was when it first showed, once a session.

surjeetbanga.logline/panel_action.comment: Something done in the Logs panel, once a session for each kind.

action.comment: The action, by name, such as inspect_event or export.

surjeetbanga.logline/welcome.comment: Which option was chosen in the first-run welcome.

choice.comment: The option, such as tour or capture; dismissed for Escape.

agent.comment: Which agent: host, claude, codex, other, or none.

outcome.comment: What happened, such as added, copied, or cancelled.

surjeetbanga.logline/agent_onboarding.comment: The one-step agent setup was offered, answered, finished, or stopped at a step.

step.comment: One of: offered, accepted, declined, dismissed, finished, failed_connect, failed_share.

agent.comment: One of: host, claude, codex, copilot.

surjeetbanga.logline/nudge.comment: A notification Logline raised on its own, and how it was answered.

kind.comment: One of: errors, capture_offer, capture_notice, browser_offer, no_integration.

step.comment: One of: shown, accepted, never, dismissed.

surjeetbanga.logline/entry.comment: Logline was opened from outside the Logs panel.

from.comment: One of: status_bar, explorer, editor, terminal_menu, empty_state, agent_hint, add_menu.

surjeetbanga.logline/prompt_answered.comment: How the rating, feedback, or update question was answered.

answer.comment: Accepted, later, never, dismissed, or failed.
